teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Helped peers trace short programs step by step, covering functions, lists, and arrays.
Explained worked examples under a course instructor's supervision and supported beginner programming practice sessions.

projects.title: Binary File Reader
bullets: Contributed to a team binary file reader project in C, tracing program behaviour using a debugger.
Documented the program structure and test cases, checked array bounds and error paths, and used Git.
